faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear, straight answers on waste segregation and recycling.
faq.q1: How does WasteWise AI identify materials accurately?
faq.a1: WasteWise uses multimodal Google Gemini Vision AI to analyze physical visual cues like texture, transparency, shape, and recycling resin codes on packaging.
faq.q2: Why is segregating waste so critical in India?
faq.a2: Unsegregated wet and dry waste contaminates recyclables, causing over 80% of urban waste to rot in toxic landfills and release methane.
faq.q3: How do I dispose of hazardous or electronic waste?
faq.a3: E-waste and hazardous items like batteries and CFL bulbs must never go into domestic dry or wet bins. Use our Recycling Centers page to find authorized drop-off facilities.
faq.q4: What are Eco-Points and how are they calculated?
faq.a4: Every verified scan awards 10 to 30 Eco-Points based on material recyclability and estimated CO2 emission reductions.
faq.q5: Can I use WasteWise AI in my local language?
faq.a5: Yes! WasteWise AI supports 10 languages including English, Hindi, Hinglish, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Punjabi, and Kannada with complete voice synthesis and recognition.
faq.q6: Is WasteWise AI completely free for citizens?
faq.a6: Yes, 100% free with no account signup required. Anyone with a camera and web browser can scan items instantly.

eco_tips_list.tip: Rinse plastic containers & bottles before disposal — leftover residues can spoil an entire batch of recyclable polymers.
Greasy pizza boxes belong in compost or dry waste, not paper recycling, as oil prevents paper fiber repulping.
Never throw lithium-ion batteries into normal bins. Store them dry and drop them at certified E-waste collection points.
Keep bottle caps screwed onto plastic bottles before recycling. Modern optical sorters separate caps from PET automatically.
Kitchen organic waste (peels, tea grounds, food scraps) produces nutrient-rich organic compost in just 3 to 4 weeks.
Shredded paper fibers are too short for normal paper recycling. Add them directly to your home compost bin instead.
Clean and crush aluminum beverage cans — aluminum can be recycled infinitely with 95% less energy than raw bauxite.
Factory reset and wipe personal data from obsolete electronics before handing them over to certified municipal recyclers.
Fluorescent tubes and CFL bulbs contain trace mercury vapors. Wrap them safely and dispose of them strictly as Hazardous Waste.
Donate clean, unsoiled garments to textile drives or upcycle old fabrics into reusable cleaning rags before discarding.
